comments.author: Lisa
comments.body:
Carla is right. All ships can only have 2 optional skills and 1 original.
My MTC came with improvement 1/5 and the optional skill Bullet-Proof armouring. As this normally requires a R12 SB to put on this skill I decided to leave it as was rather than stripping the ship.
Used the 4/5 slots to gain a 2nd optional skill of EA. This did mean of course that my ship did not get to max improved speed or high turn until the Company Cities became available and I could add improvements 6 & 7.
Now deciding which, if any, original skill to add. Thinking either Improved Hold if keeping it as a Cargo ship or Pre-emptive attack if I go to use it as a fast attack ship. As currently it has 90 crew and 56 cannon.
